local p = Players[0]
if p == nil then print("ERR:NO_PLAYER|0") print("---END---") return end
local c = p:GetCities():FindID(1)
if c == nil then print("ERR:NO_CITY|player 0 has no city 1") print("---END---") return end
print("CITYPOS|" .. c:GetX() .. "|" .. c:GetY() .. "|" .. Locale.Lookup(c:GetName()):gsub("|","/"))
print("---END---")

local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local unit = UnitManager.GetUnit(me, 12) if unit == nil then print("ERR:UNIT_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
if unit:GetMovesRemaining() == 0 then print("ERR:NO_MOVES|Trader has no moves remaining"); print("---END---"); return end
local destCity = CityManager.GetCityAt(44, 8)
if destCity == nil then print("ERR:NO_CITY|No city at ({target_x},{target_y})"); print("---END---"); return end
local opHash = UnitOperationTypes.MAKE_TRADE_ROUTE
local tParams = {}
tParams[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_X0] = 44
tParams[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_Y0] = 8
tParams[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_X1] = unit:GetX()
tParams[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_Y1] = unit:GetY()
if not UnitManager.CanStartOperation(unit, opHash, nil, tParams) then
    local pTrade = Players[me]:GetTrade()
    local nOut = pTrade:GetNumOutgoingRoutes()
    local cap = pTrade:GetOutgoingRouteCapacity()
    if nOut >= cap then
        print("ERR:CAPACITY_FULL|Trade routes at capacity (" .. nOut .. "/" .. cap .. "). Build Markets/Lighthouses for more slots, or wait for current route to finish."); print("---END---"); return
    else
        print("ERR:CANNOT_START_ROUTE|CanStartOperation returned false for destination (44,8)"); print("---END---"); return
    end
end
UnitManager.RequestOperation(unit, opHash, tParams)
local destName = Locale.Lookup(destCity:GetName())
print("OK:TRADE_ROUTE_STARTED|to " .. destName .. " at (44,8)")
print("---END---")
